title: ADFF Returns to the TIFF Lightbox with The Tower That Built A City and Much More
summary:
ADFF, the Architecture & Design Film Festival, is returning to the TIFF Lightbox in two weeks, November 4 through 7, 2026, with seventeen screenings in total. Presented by Eventscape, the festival opens with a Wednesday, November 4 evening premiere and party, continuing on the Thursday and Friday evenings, and going all day on Saturday the 7th.

The festival's offerings this year cover famous buildings — the CN Tower here in Toronto, COPAN in Sao Paulo, and five buildings by celebrated architect Renzo Piano — the work of overlooked female architects generally and Barbara Buser specifically,
